sources.title: Simple RSI Strategy - Rule Based Higher Timeframe Trading
sources.claim_summary: The public script buys when RSI reaches 30 and exits when RSI reaches 40.

hypothesis: A liquid instrument with an unusually low RSI may experience short-horizon mean reversion.
entry_rule: Buy at the next open when RSI(14) is below 30.
sizing_rule: Use one full long position; portfolio-level limits are not specified by the source.
ambiguities: The source does not define a universal asset universe or portfolio-level sizing rule.
